Class Item

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.project2.csce331.Item
public class Item extends Object
Represents an item in the POS system, such as a menu item or product.

Each item has the following properties:

  • id: Unique identifier for the item.
  • name: Name of the item.
  • popularity: Popularity score of the item.
  • price: Price of the item.
  • state: Availability status of the item (active/inactive).
  • ingredients: List of ingredient IDs associated with the item.
Author:
Daniel Zhang

  • Constructor Details

    • Item

      public Item(int id, String name, int popularity, double price, ArrayList<Integer> ingredients) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Constructs a new Item with the given id, name, popularity, price, and ingredients. The item state is set to active by default.
      Parameters:
      id - Unique identifier for the item. Must be non-negative.
      name - Name of the item.
      popularity - Popularity score. Must be non-negative.
      price - Price of the item. Must be non-negative.
      ingredients - List of ingredient IDs. Cannot be null.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if id, popularity, or price is negative, or if ingredients is null.
